decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software sits at the core of the firm's automation and software knowledge and fits its move toward data-driven infrastructure management, so its own R&D can keep interpreting user feedback and improving it, even though the parallel Product B was dropped.

Flow measurement automation and system software builds directly on the firm's established water-infrastructure expertise and in-house software development, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from early results and keep developing the product.
